name: Twilio Docs MCP
summary: Twilio's hosted, read-only MCP server that lets agents search Twilio, SendGrid and Segment docs and Twilio's public OpenAPI specs.
description: Remote server at https://mcp.twilio.com/docs, in Public Beta. No authentication. Two tools: `twilio__search` to find docs pages and API operations, and `twilio__retrieve` to fetch their full content. It only reads documentation and public specs and cannot make Twilio API calls; for that, use the separate Twilio Labs MCP server. Live probe returned server name twilio-docs-mcp 0.1.0.

agent_access.notes: Streamable HTTP; read-only docs and OpenAPI search.
